title: Li-Mohanram (2014) mechanical earnings forecasts on a unit-consistent free EDGAR PIT panel, FY1-FY3 validation
authority: Owner directive 2026-08-07 sections 5-6, 14. DEC-291. Public surface stays KEEP_QUARANTINED.
literature_anchor: Unchanged from v1: Li-Mohanram 2014 RAST, local pdf/txt in data/edgar/literature/, equations (2),(3),(7), section 3.2, Appendix A.

unit_basis_precommitted.single_split_basis: ONE basis for the entire panel: today s. Every per-share quantity - eps_t, bps_t, tacc_t, and the dependent eps_(t+tau) - divides by shares_basis(t) = shares_reported(t) x F, where F = product of ALL entries in the symbol s fetched splits map dated strictly AFTER the period_end of the year-t share fact used for that row (the R0-CORRECTED F rule applied to shares; spinoff ratios included). This keeps Appendix A faithful (the deflator is still the year-t share count, expressed on a consistent basis) and makes per-share magnitudes comparable across years, so the pooled regression fits one scale (BLOCKER 2 fix).
unit_basis_precommitted.price_leg: Prices stay today-basis as fetched (Yahoo v8 chart split-adjusted closes). NO conversion is applied anywhere: error scaling divides by the today-basis close on or before June 30 of the origin year (10-trading-day tolerance). The shares leg and the price leg are on the same basis by construction.
unit_basis_precommitted.share_fact_selection: Year-t shares = the EDGAR share fact (us-gaap CommonStockSharesOutstanding) with date within [period_end - 183d, period_end + 90d], filed <= origin for pool rows and filed <= origin for the live forecast row, closest date to period_end, ties latest date (ISSUE 8: per base year, never an origin-wide snapshot). A firm-year without such a fact is excluded and counted.
unit_consistency_assertions_gate: Premise checks (series IS adjusted): split-adjusted close shows no jump > 3% across AAPL 2020-08-31 and NVDA 2021-07-20 / 2024-06-10, and the fetched splits maps contain those entries

ABSOLUTE reference (catches inversion): AAPL close on 2019-06-28 as stored is within 2% of 49.48 (today-basis) AND within 2% of 197.9 after multiplying by the post-origin factor 4 - a divide-by-F implementation would show ~12.4 and fail (ISSUE 9)

Definitional identity, tolerance-free and checked on EVERY forecast row: aligned_dependent(t+tau) x shares_basis(t) == raw total earnings E_(t+tau) to relative 1e-9; and shares_basis(t)/shares_reported(t) == F computed from the splits map (catches any basis error, ISSUE 9)
Coverage floor: price-covered share of the universe >= 0.95, else hard-fail the run

models_frozen.EP: eps(t+tau) = b0 + b1*NegE_t + b2*eps_t + b3*(NegE_t*eps_t) + e. Baseline 2.
models_frozen.RI: eps(t+tau) = c0 + c1*NegE_t + c2*eps_t + c3*(NegE_t*eps_t) + c4*bps_t + c5*tacc_t + e. Primary.
models_frozen.expected_signs: RI: c2>0, c4>0, c3<0, c5<0. Reported, not enforced.
models_frozen.estimation: Pooled OLS per tau in {1,2,3}, 10-year trailing pool, firm-year rows with all regressors available; forecast requires non-missing regressors at t; missing TACC -> 0 flagged (paper).
models_frozen.pool_definition: ISSUES 4+10 resolved: for origin June-30 of year Y and horizon tau, base fiscal years are those with period_end between April 1 of (Y-tau-10) and March 31 of (Y-tau) inclusive - the paper s own per-horizon shift (base-year labels Y-tau-9..Y-tau (ten FYE-convention years), so every tau keeps ten years of pairs) - and a pair (t, t+tau) enters the pool only if BOTH the base and the dependent annual facts are filed <= June-30 of Y. Self-enforcing: any fact with filed > origin enters nothing in estimation. The live forecast uses base t* = latest usable fiscal year at origin (FYE guard), with the realized dependent fetched under the evaluation cutoff 2026-08-07 as an outcome only.
models_frozen.fye_rule: Unchanged from v1 (paper line 454 restatement, cleared by red team).
models_frozen.winsorization: All continuous variables winsorized at 1/99 within each fiscal year from the estimation pool (paper). ISSUE 6 resolved: forecast rows at fiscal year t outside the pool's year range take the boundaries of the most recent pool year (declared rule; boundaries never use data filed after the origin).

variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.earnings_E: Unchanged from v1.1: primary IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntity, fallback NetIncomeLoss, recorded per firm-year. Declared deviation: SPI not separable on EDGAR.
variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.spi_deviation_handling: ISSUE 5 resolved by advance declaration: the gate is measured on a construction that includes special items (the paper footnote covers among-model rank order, not RI-vs-RW). Mitigation pre-committed: report the gate on (i) full sample, (ii) loss-firm subsample, (iii) large-unusual-items-excluded subsample, where unusual = RestructuringCharges + GoodwillImpairmentLoss + AssetImpairmentLoss (any present) exceeding 1% of total assets. RW's structural exposure to SPI (forecast = E_t carried at full weight) is stated in the artifact.
variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.shares: Year-t shares = union of dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding and us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding facts (earliest-filed-per-date), then selection per unit_basis_precommitted.share_fact_selection. The dei tag is the cover-page count, near-universal; the initial fetch omitted it (fetcher error, not a criteria change) and is re-fetched pre-run.
variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.tacc: Telescoped Richardson accruals with the L = A - E substitution (red-team fix b): TACC_t = [ (SE - CHE + IVST - PSTK)_t - (SE - CHE + IVST - PSTK)_{t-1} ] / shares_basis(t), where SE = StockholdersEquity, CHE = CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue, IVST = ShortTermInvestments (fallback MarketableSecuritiesCurrent, missing -> 0), PSTK = PreferredStockValue (missing -> 0). Assets and Liabilities drop out; declared approximation error = dNCI (parent-only SE vs total equity), small. Missing TACC -> 0 flagged (paper).
variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.fact_selection: Annual facts only: form in {10-K, 10-K/A}, fp=FY; PIT: filed <= as-of, earliest filed per period (e2 rule, red-team cleared).

universe_precommitted: Unchanged from v1.1: slickcharts S&P500 (2026-08-02, 503) union rim-dow 30; symbol->CIK via company_tickers.json with dot-to-dash normalization and the AEP fallback; survivorship bound stated; minimum pool 300 firm-years; all industries; SIC from SEC submissions metadata (fetch stage 2 already run). MANDATED DECLARATION (red-team fh-058): the validation artifact must report the effective universe - symbols fetched, symbols surviving each tag requirement, retention rate, and the SIC distribution of the dropped set versus the kept set. The result is a statement about the retained subset, not the S&P500.
sample_precommitted: Unchanged from v1.1: origins June 30 of 2019-2023; tau 1..3; origin 2023 tau=3 evaluated on available actuals only; no imputation; evaluation actuals cutoff 2026-08-07.

price_source.source: Yahoo v8 chart API per r1-criteria-v1.1 (repo precedent), fetched with events=splits; the splits maps serve ONLY the shares-leg F computation. Stooq remains unusable (PoW challenge) - not retried.
price_source.scaling: Forecast error = actual - forecast (per shares_basis(t)), scaled by the today-basis close: last close on/before June 30 of the origin year, 10-trading-day tolerance. Missing price -> symbol excluded from price-scaled metrics and counted; coverage floor 0.95 hard-fails the run.

buckets: size terciles by total assets (declared proxy)
validation_design.comparisons: RI vs RW, RI vs EP, EP vs RW on every metric/bucket/subsample

necessary_and_sufficient_declared.necessary_to_proceed_to_R2: RI price-scaled MAE < RW price-scaled MAE at BOTH tau=1 and tau=2 on the FULL sample
necessary_and_sufficient_declared.model_selection_for_R2_input: whichever of RI/EP has lower average price-scaled MAE across tau=1..3 (full sample) is primary for R2; the other is sensitivity
necessary_and_sufficient_declared.no_veto_legs: No additional leg can veto the gate; subsample and bucket results are diagnostics and must be reported in full regardless of direction (red-team fh-023/fh-036 asks)
necessary_and_sufficient_declared.if_ri_fails_rw: Stop; do not embed these forecasts in R2; report cause. Recovery proceeds to the data decision (C) or retirement (D) on that evidence (directive section 5.3).

validation_design.coefficient_diagnostics: Per-tau pooled coefficients with OLS se and expected-sign comparison; inversions reported, not gated.

prohibitions: No universe, window, metric, scaling, basis rule or source change after results are observed.
No paid data, account creation, login (directive sections 3, 8).
No Oracle data in the deployable path.
No public number republication; quarantine untouched.
Criteria and receipt commit in a separate earlier commit than any result.

amendment_reason: Red-team re-review found: (1) MUST-FIX leftover wording - price_source still said origin-basis while unit_basis said today-basis (contradictory instruction; the fix is deleting the stale wording, exactly as the red team prescribed, no review window requested); (2) universe silently halves on filing practice - measured tag coverage: all-required-tags firms 273/501 = 54.5%, driven by us-gaap CommonStockSharesOutstanding (76.2%, the fetch never requested the dei tag that the criteria text always named) and Liabilities (73.3%). Two red-team-recommended data-assembly fixes adopted: (a) re-fetch dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding and union with the us-gaap tag (the e2 precedent and the v2 text); (b) substitute L = A - E into the telescoped TACC so TACC = d(StockholdersEquity - Cash + ShortTermInvestments - PreferredStockValue)/shares_basis - Assets and Liabilities drop out, required coverage rises 273 -> 355 firms, approximation error is dNCI only (us-gaap StockholdersEquity is parent-only), small and declared; the alternative (zeroing TACC for 27% of firms) would collapse RI toward EP in exactly the comparison under test. Plus: effective-universe reporting mandated in the artifact, and the cosmetic label fix (Y-tau-9..Y-tau).
